Rhok'zan from Sucker for Love

Rhok’zan from the video game Sucker for Love: Date to Die For (2024), a 90s anime-inspired Lovecraftian visual novel where the protagonist Stardust is kidnapped in the Black Woods of Sacramen-Cho and uses a cultist spellbook to survive, is the main dateable eldritch entity known as The Black Goat of the Woods. The game presents her as the figure whose aura has placed much of the town under her influence, while Stardust remains unusually unaffected and can summon her through rituals in the purple spellbook. She is a goat-themed fertility goddess tied to The Thousand Young, serving as the central supernatural presence of the game rather than one of several romance options like in the first title. Her story connects romance, horror, cult rituals, and survival, with the player’s choices across the four chapters shaping how Stardust’s relationship with her develops and which ending
